name: Unrequited Love
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Tarrel reads the note.>Oh... oh my. Poor Hollee.She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
